title: RemoteNof1CardiologyObservationLog
description: Unified data dictionary mapping continuous digital health metrics to FHIR Observation profiles for decentralized cardiovascular trials.

Patient_ID.description: Anonymized pseudo-identifier linked to the master hospital EHR resource map.

Phenotype.description: Clinical stratification profile defining baseline digital tracker compliance boundaries.

Observation_Day.description: Sequential trial timeline tracker mapped to the active multi-period crossover schedule.

Assigned_Treatment.description: Active therapeutic policy context (Strategy A: Standard reference GDMT vs Strategy B: Hyper-titrated active protocol).

True_Latent_Signal.description: The uncorrupted underlying patient physiological state proxy used for internal simulation calibration.

Observed_Sensor_Value.description: The real-world telemetry input data, embedding hardware communication drops and artifact noise levels.
